about: The 30-day Coversyl supply covers 28 May, when the patient starts brand-only Urocit-K, an oral potassium citrate tablet.
The 30-day Atacand supply covers 11 March, when the patient starts brand-only Chlorvescent containing potassium chloride, potassium bicarbonate and potassium carbonate.
Tritace is present with Movicol sachets only and no oral potassium supplement.
